text:
Lina: FYI Veridian Systems POC approved. They asked for hosted API tokens scoped to generation+embeddings, per-integration keys (so they can revoke individually), IP allowlist 198.51.100.42/32, audit export to their S3, and an automatic kill at the end of the 7-day trial. Who can own token creation + rotation?

Tom: Security preferences: use ephemeral tokens only for the POC, prefer TTL <= 72h, require issuance, rotation and revoke events in audit logs with actor and key_id. For S3 export we need the bucket ARN and a cross-account role that allows PutObject. No CMK requested.

Ravi: I'll create the tokens. Suggest 72h TTL to reduce churn, with a 1h overlap during rotation (create new, wait 1h, revoke old). Sample redwoodctl command:```bash
redwoodctl keys create \
  --type=ephemeral \
  --scopes=generation,embeddings \
  --allowed-ips=198.51.100.42/32 \
  --ttl=72h \
  --note="Veridian-<integration>"
```We will name per-integration tokens like `Veridian-frontend`, `Veridian-worker`, etc. Tokens delivered via secure transfer link or their vault.

Veridian-Eng: We'll take the tokens in our HashiVault. Please include a machine-readable JSON with key_id, created_at, expires_at so we can automate rotation on our side.

Ravi: Will include that. Also adding a rate-limit of 200rpm per token unless they request otherwise. Example usage to include in handoff doc:```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize clinical notes"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

Tom: Make sure issuance events include the SE who created the token and the note field. Compliance wants rotation events to include previous_key_id -> new_key_id mapping.

Ravi: I'll add a post-creation audit annotation. For rotation automation I propose: 1) create new key, 2) deliver token to their vault, 3) wait 1h, 4) revoke old key with `redwoodctl keys revoke <old_key_id>`. I'll own the automation.

Lina: Also ask Veridian for the S3 ARN and point-of-contact for the IAM role. We need that to wire audit export before issuing tokens.

ops-bot: Reminder task created -> "Veridian POC: collect S3 ARN" scheduled for 2237893723. :robot_face:

Veridian-Eng: We'll provide the bucket ARN and create the cross-account role. Also please add a 7-day revoke schedule and tell us how to request an extension.

Ravi: I'll create tokens with server-side expiry and schedule a revoke job at day 7 00:00 UTC. If they request extension we'll update TTL and rotation job. I'll include extension instructions in the handoff doc.

Tom: One more: avoid issuing any long-lived tokens for demo users. If they need local developer access, issue scoped short-lived tokens and document how to request more.

Lina: Owners: Ravi = token creation + docs, Ravi+ops = rotation automation, Tom = compliance sign-off. I'll coordinate with Veridian for the ARN and integration list. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
